rationale: Static guidance document on negative references — read once to interpret the blacklist register, not a recurring signal producer; URL unverified.
BJN annual procurement statistics category page publishes recurring system-wide volume and red-flag data — core A2 baseline.
Ministry-of-finance institutional stub about BJN; covered by monitoring BJN itself, adds no independent output.
NBRSM authoritative register of licensed banks, savings houses and other financial institutions — the actor spine for MK banking/payments procurement.
Static bank leading-number identifier list — mine once as a join key, refresh rarely.
NBRSM credit-registry info page; a section of the central-bank site with little standalone procurement signal, though MKB is a relevant buyer.
Only MK e-commerce/payments-acceptance association; covers PSP and card-scheme actor set neither MBA nor MASIT reaches.
Low-credibility third-party org directory duplicating official registry data already covered.
FOI platform indexing public bodies — useful once as a route to unpublished registers; reachability and reuse terms unclear.
National statistics office gives recurring business-demography and ICT/finance series for sizing and sanity checks.
Single 2020 appeals-commission annual report PDF — valuable evidence, but the DKZJN reports index is the thing to monitor.
Possible searchable e-appeals case application; highest structured value if real, but liveness and access terms unconfirmed.
State Audit Office report repository names contracts, suppliers and pricing for banking/payment services — deepest recurring A2 disclosure.
Planned-audits register is a forward-looking early-warning feed with filterable query parameters.
Entity taxonomy pages are a crawl pattern within dzr.mk already monitored; keep as harvesting structure, not a separate source.
Competition authority publishes concentration notifications and fee/cartel decisions touching bank, acquirer and card-scheme market structure and bid-rigging.
Static institutional link directory — snowball once for peer regulators; no ongoing signal, URL unverified.
Anti-corruption commission publishes procurement case initiations naming contracting authorities and suppliers; recurring output.
Administrative Court decisions give the richest detail on contested tenders, but the portal did not verify and its access/scraping terms are unclear.
ASPI holders-of-information directory supplies FOI contact points for the oversight bodies — mine once, refresh occasionally.
Prosecution press and indictment announcements escalate audit findings and add named contracts and suppliers.
Constitutional Court decisions are low-frequency and mostly upstream of A2; monitor only if cheap once liveness is confirmed.
Investigative outlet acts as a low-latency tripwire on audit and appeal findings; useful despite moderate credibility.
